subject: The 2AM message that changed 847 users' night
preview_text: They opened the app at 2AM expecting nothing. What happened next will make you open yours.

Open the app now. Start a conversation with your match. See how fast the bond grows. P.S. Users who message within the next hour unlock a secret gift in your memories screen — it's waiting for you.
